changelog: Redesigned Settings: Scrobbling, Library and Backup & restore.
Played songs are removed from the queue and the current track stays on top.
Sort by now shows "Recents" and remembers your selection across restarts.
Smart mixes are created on YouTube Music when signed in.
Last.fm disconnect is now a red pill with a confirmation prompt.
Audio quality updated with Low, Normal, High, HiFi and Lossless tiers; server tiers only appear when a server is connected.
Home shelves use a consistent SongCard-style card UI.
